$comment: IRS e-file XML -> filings columns. Language-neutral by design: the browser
reader (lib/ingest/efile-map.ts) and scripts/ingest.py both consume THIS file,
so a wrong path is fixed in one place rather than two.
Paths are '/'-separated element names relative to the stated root, in the
http://www.irs.gov/efile namespace. Parts VIII-X of the 990 report through
'*Grp' containers holding BOYAmt/EOYAmt pairs or a functional-expense split,
which is why a column maps to a path and not a bare tag name.
2022v5.0-2025v4.0). Every Part I path resolves in 100% of 990s in every
version; no element is renamed across versions. Lower resolution rates on
detail paths are filer variation, not schema variation.
net assets. The pre-2018 TempRstr/PrmnntRstr elements do not appear at all.

990.$note: Part IX line items read column A (TotalAmt) — the whole-organisation figure, the same basis as total_expenses. The three functional columns (ProgramServicesAmt / ManagementAndGeneralAmt / FundraisingAmt) stay mapped to program_expenses / ga_expenses / fundraising_expenses; the two answer different questions and the SOI extracts populate only the line items, so dropping either would leave a gap across sources.

990EZ.$note: 990-EZ has no functional-expense split, so ga_expenses and fundraising_expenses stay null. other_revenue is derived. The EZ has no Part IX. Its expense lines are coarser and mostly combined (SalariesOtherCompEmplBnftAmt merges salaries, other compensation and benefits), so only occupancy maps cleanly to an existing column.

990PF.$note: A private foundation has no program-service revenue line, so program_revenue stays null. The four-column PF layout (RevAndExpnss / NetInvstIncm / AdjNetIncm / DsbrsChrtbl) is deliberately read from the RevAndExpnss column only, which is the books figure comparable to a 990's totals. Part I expense lines are mapped only where they are 1:1 with a column: PF combines pension plans with employee benefits, and travel with conferences and meetings, so those lines are left unmapped rather than loaded into a column that means something narrower.

derived.$note: total_revenue minus contributions, program_revenue and investment_income. The 990 reports CYOtherRevenueAmt directly and is excluded. Matches how scripts/ingest.py derives it for the SOI extracts.
